_about: Every item in the game. Referenced by id from shops, loot tables, quests, world loot and saves: never rename an id. `rarity` is a rarities.json id. `reservedFor` lists the only loot tables that may drop an item (a boss's own weapon).

items.name: Worn longsword
items.description: Your own blade. Nicked, honest and in need of a whetstone.

items.name: Watchman's Edge
items.description: A soldier's sword in better repair than its last owner. The watch sigil is still legible on the guard.

items.name: Travelling clothes
items.description: Wool and leather, patched at the elbows. Keeps the rain off, mostly.

items.name: Dented watch helm
items.description: An iron cap from the old garrison. Someone took a blow in it and walked away.

items.name: Battered kite shield
items.description: Oak boards under a skin of hide, rimmed in iron. It has turned a good many blows.

items.name: Traveller's satchel
items.description: A sturdy shoulder bag. Place it in an empty bag slot to carry more.

items.name: Healing draught
items.description: A small bottle of something bitter and red. Restores 42 health.

items.name: Grave-iron bar
items.description: A short bar of dark iron, cold to the touch and stamped with a smith's mark.

items.name: Carriage manifest
items.description: A carter's manifest, damp at the edges. The driver's name has been scratched out.

items.name: Iron-studded gloves
items.description: Thick leather with iron studs across the knuckles. Mara's own pattern.

items.name: Hobnailed boots
items.description: Heavy boots with iron nails in the soles. They grip a wet road.

items.name: Mail chausses
items.description: Riveted mail leggings, re-linked where someone was unlucky.

items.name: Iron-faced kite shield
items.description: Oak under a skin of hammered iron, brass at the rim. Heavy, and worth it.

items.name: Rusted falchion
items.description: A broad, back-heavy blade gone orange at the spine. It still bites.

items.name: Warden's hauberk
items.description: Riveted mail to the knee, the watch's tower stitched on the breast. Someone wore it here before you.

items.name: Blackened sabatons
items.description: Plate boots scorched black. The straps are new.

items.name: Blackwood cleaver
items.description: Grave-iron hammered thin around a core of black wood. It is warm in the hand.

items.name: Barrow hound pelt
items.description: Coarse grey fur that smells of turned earth. A tanner would take it.

items.name: Cracked bone
items.description: A thigh bone, split along its length. Not yours, which is something.

items.name: Bent arrowheads
items.description: Iron heads, too bent to fly true. A smith will take them for the metal.

items.name: Raw hound flank
items.description: Dark, lean meat from a barrow hound. A cook with a strong stomach would want it.

items.name: Helm of the Old Watch
items.description: A captain's helm from before the road fell, its brass crest still bright. Whoever wore it last kept the watch to the end.

items.name: Witchbane
items.description: The seer kept this blade bound in roots so no hand could lift it against her. The witchlight in the fuller has not gone out.

items.name: Pitch torch
items.description: Rags soaked in pitch, bound to a stave. Carried in the off hand, it lights the dark places, at the cost of your shield.

items.name: Fishing rod
items.description: Ash and horsehair line. Keep it in your bags to fish, once someone has shown you how.

items.name: Gloomwater perch
items.description: Striped and bad-tempered. Good eating, by the standards of the road.

items.name: Silver dace
items.description: A quick, bright little fish. Tam says they bite best in the evening.

items.name: Barrow eel
items.description: Black as the mere's bottom and nearly as old. Tam has caught two in forty years.

items.name: Waterlogged boot
items.description: Somebody's boot. You decide not to wonder where the rest of them is.
